course_name_original: Agricultural and Food Industry Electric Equipment
course_name_en: Agricultural and Food Industry Electric Equipment
syllabus_topics: Farming electric equipment: seed cleaning and drying installations, greenhouses
Electric equipment in stock-breeding: food preparation and distribution aggregates, shearing, ventilations and heating systems in stock-breeding and poultry
Electric equipment of metal cutting machines and food industry machines
teaching_methods: Practical exercises on cycle with industrial models
Tasks for nonstandard scheme decisions of management schemes during exercises
assessment_rules: The exam consists of a written part (two questions) and an oral examination. Students are allowed to attend the exercises if they have shown enough knowledge on oral examination. Students pass short time written exams through the lectures.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS FEEA (datos antiguos; ver notas)
